mapper.insert: insert into address_book (user_id, sex, province_name, province_code, phone, label, is_default, district_name, district_code, detail,consignee, city_name,city_code) values (#{userId}, #{sex}, #{provinceName}, #{provinceCode}, #{phone}, #{label}, #{isDefault}, #{districtName}, #{districtCode}, #{detail},#{consignee}, #{cityName},#{cityCode})
mapper.update: update address_book set is_default = 1 where id = #{id}
update address_book set is_default = 0 where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select * from address_book where user_id = #{userId} and is_default = 1
